text:
Anya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — small canary bursts + KV-cache warmup caused a p99 spike. We agreed we need clearer canary sizing, blast-radius controls, and an auto-rollback path.

Raj: I'll draft the auto-rollback spec and a minimal controller prototype. estimate 1 week for draft + staging tests.

Drew: I'll add blast-radius params to the flag service and prefer server-side filtering. will also add a migration plan.

Anya: ACTIONS: 1) AUTO-ROLLBACK SPEC + PROTO - Raj - due 2024-07-01; 2) BLAST-RADIUS FLAGS + MIGRATION - Drew - due 2024-07-04; 3) CANARY SIZE PLAYBOOK + RUNBOOK ENTRY - Anya - due 2024-06-26; 4) SLA ALERT + ROLLBACK HOOK - eng-sre - due 2024-06-26.

Raj: watcher will evaluate p99 + error_rate over 3-min windows and trigger rollback if thresholds breached. controller needs idempotency and audit logging.

Drew: server-side gives deterministic targeting; client sampling may hide small-canary telemetry. will default early canaries to 0.5%.

ops-bot: ticket PLAT-5180 created: "canary safety + auto-rollback" assigned raj/drew/anya/eng-sre — https://redwood.internal/tickets/PLAT-5180

Anya: scheduling 20-min sync Fri 11:00 to review PRs and staging dry-run checklist. please add PR links to PLAT-5180 when ready.

eng-sre: we'll run a dry-run in staging and require two successful simulated rollbacks before enabling auto-rollback in prod.

Drew: starting branch for flag changes and will post short migration notes in the ticket.

Raj: will include a simulated-trigger mode in the watcher so SRE can validate alerts trigger the controller in staging.

Anya: thanks — marking postmortem follow-up as tracking; will close when PLAT-5180 has PRs, tests, and runbook entries.
